facts.fact: The article's publication date is May 3, 2026.

facts.fact: The guide compares 10 platforms, which the author describes as the most credible AI agent platforms in 2026.

facts.fact: Per the vendor's own claim, Deskferry offers 1,500+ app integrations and 200+ pre-built agent templates.
